title: Abraxas — Gnostic World
summary: Gnostic cosmology + surreal skeleton world. AI-generated entities ascending through 7 Archon realms. TikTok content engine + potential mobile app.

overview.what: A creative project building a world based on Gnostic cosmology — specifically Jung's psychological decoding of Gnostic texts. Skeleton entities as divine sparks ascending through 7 Archon-controlled realms toward Abraxas (the supreme being above the Demiurge). Visual assets started. Needs a plan before building any system.
overview.status_detail: Philosophy locked. Visual assets started (hero images, archon screens). Interactive explorer exists. But no clear production pipeline or content strategy yet.

columns.name: Define the actual product
values: What are we actually making? TikTok videos? An app? A website? A game?
Decide: is this content (videos/images) or a product (app/game)? Can't build a system without knowing what it serves.

columns.name: Content pipeline test
values: Make 5 pieces of Abraxas content and post them
Generate 5 skeleton-in-archon-realm images with AI, add lore captions, post to TikTok/Instagram. See what resonates.

columns.name: Map the 7 realms
values: Define each Archon realm's visual style, rules, and narrative
The 7 Archons are named. Each needs: color palette, environment style, challenge/theme, what the skeleton learns there.

columns.name: Explorer app design
values: Interactive experience for exploring the Gnostic world
Don't build more until the content direction is clear. The explorer is a tool, not the product.

considerations.label: Don't build a system before you need one
considerations.detail: The temptation is to architect an elaborate app. But first: does anyone care about this content? Test with 5 posts before building anything.

considerations.label: Source material
considerations.detail: Jung's psychological decoding of Gnostic texts (full text available). Abraxas = 365-lettered name, solar rooster head, supreme being.

considerations.label: Visual direction
considerations.detail: AI-generated surreal skeleton entities. Dark, dreamlike, symbolic. Each realm has distinct visual language.

considerations.label: Separate from Cognition OS
considerations.detail: This is a DIFFERENT project from Cognition OS. Don't let them blur together.

notes:
The 7 Archon Realms:
1. Yaldabaoth (Saturn) — the Demiurge, creator of the material prison
2. Eloaeus (Jupiter) — law, authority, rigid order
3. Astaphaeus (Mars) — war, conflict, the trial of will
4. Adonaios (Sun) — ego, false light, the illusion of self
5. Sabaoth (Venus) — desire, attachment, the trap of beauty
6. Airamaoth (Mercury) — knowledge without wisdom, the maze of intellect
7. Horaios (Moon) — reflection, shadow self, the final gate

Beyond all 7: Abraxas — totality, beyond good and evil.

The honest next step: make 5 pieces of content and post them. Everything else is premature.
